sections.heading: Zyte limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products; Does not outrank Bright Data (7.7); list price monthly commit is not unlimited extraction; PAYG meters still apply because it forces process changes or add-ons around Zyte when CI/CD and automation is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Monthly commitment with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain CI/CD and automation at the expense of Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Monthly commitment · CI/CD and automation | Pay-as-you-go | Enterprise.

Alternative context: unlike Bright Data, Zyte is preferable when Teams that knew Scrapinghub and need the Zyte API extraction path because CI/CD and automation plus CI/CD and automation match; prefer Bright Data when Enterprises that require Bright Data / Oxylabs proxy-estate compliance packaging because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Zyte
sections.body:
Scenario: recommend Zyte for Teams that knew Scrapinghub and need the Zyte API extraction path; do not choose it when Enterprises that require Bright Data / Oxylabs proxy-estate compliance packaging — the jobs diverge at CI/CD and automation.

Implementation time: weeks to configure CI/CD and automation if Python, Scrapy must be green before invites.

Integrations in research: Python, Scrapy.

Decision conclusion: buy Zyte when researched fit (Teams that knew Scrapinghub and need the Zyte API extraction path) beats researched limits (Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products); otherwise keep researching — do not substitute product names into a generic setup essay.
